summary: Require distinct declared execution units and deterministic bounded-handoff chaining for credited Adaptive Execution passes, then revalidate the merged Adaptive Execution behavior under the corrected discipline.
reason: PR #5 revision 6 recorded five SEPARATED semantic stages as complete even though they were effectively evaluated within one assistant response. The correction adds deterministic enforcement of unique declared execution-unit/boundary identities, ordered handoff chaining, closed historical exemptions, gate-before-pass chronology, historical identity uniqueness, immutable completed-pass evidence, and current artifact-state binding for partial subdivided completion. Revision-8 Adversarial has now found and corrected five successive defects or assurance gaps: omission of the PR base snapshot from historical identity checks; mutation of execution identity after durable completion; inability to represent subdivided execution honestly because subpasses were only recognized after enclosing-stage credit; failure to validate a partial subpass completion against the current governed artifact state before its handoff could be consumed; and a mapped pass-boundary evaluation specification that still described the older credited-pass model and therefore could pass without testing the new partial-state, historical-identity, immutability, and reopening protections. Procedure-coverage assessment classifies the fifth finding as already covered by the strengthened Adversarial procedure under deterministic-check overclaim and intermediate-state validation. The pass-boundary evaluation now explicitly covers ordinary, subdivided, isolated, reopened/redo, intermediate, historical/base-state, immutability, and assurance-limit scenarios. The gate used for this Adversarial attempt became stale when that governed evaluation changed and has been discarded. Adversarial remains uncredited pending a fresh retry. The repository still does not claim to prove a ChatGPT message/context boundary unless the host supplies a trustworthy boundary ID.
